assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: To-scale drawing: the long thin blue triangle ABC with A and B close together on a horizontal line, the dashed circle of Apollonius with centre O on that line, and C at the top of the circle with the dashed height 1640/9 from C down to O.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the insight that the condition BC:AC = 40:41 confines C to a circle (or an AM-GM bound on Heron's formula), so the height is maximised at its top point.
